elections.maryland.gov.en: the Maryland State Board of Elections
elections.maryland.gov.es: la Junta Electoral del Estado de Maryland (State Board of Elections)

reg_deadline.en: The advance deadline was Tuesday, October 13, 2026. You can still register and vote during early voting or at your polling place on Election Day. Bring proof of where you live, such as your MVA license or ID card, or a paycheck, bank statement, utility bill or other government document with your name and address.
reg_deadline.es: La fecha límite anticipada fue el martes 13 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes registrarte y votar durante la votación anticipada o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Lleva un comprobante de domicilio, como tu licencia o tarjeta de identificación de la MVA, o un talón de pago, un estado de cuenta bancario, un recibo de servicios u otro documento del gobierno con tu nombre y dirección.
reg_deadline.quote: For the 2026 Gubernatorial General Election, the advanced deadline to register to vote and update your information is Tuesday, October 13, 2026. ... If you can't register by the advanced deadline, go to an early voting center in the county where you live and bring a document that proves where you live. This document can be your MVA-issued license, ID card, or change of address card, or your paycheck, bank statement, utility bill, or other government document with your name and new address.
reg_deadline.notes: Election Day registration with proof of residency: Md. Election Law 3-306, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/mgawebsite/Laws/StatuteText?article=gel&section=3-306&enactments=false (Oct 28): 'On election day, an individual may appear at a precinct polling place in the individual's county of residence and apply to register to vote.'

mail_request.en: To get it by mail, request it by Tuesday, October 27, 2026. For a print-at-home ballot, by Friday, October 30. In person at your local board of elections, until 8 p.m. on November 3. Mailed or dropped-off requests must arrive by those dates.
mail_request.es: Para recibirla por correo, pídela a más tardar el martes 27 de octubre de 2026. Para una boleta que imprimes en casa, a más tardar el viernes 30 de octubre. En persona en la junta electoral de tu condado (local board of elections), hasta las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. Las solicitudes enviadas por correo o dejadas en un buzón deben llegar a más tardar en esas fechas.
mail_request.quote: Online The deadlines for requests submitted online are: Tuesday October 27, 2026 (if you want your ballot mailed to you) Friday October 30, 2026 (if you want to download and print your ballot) ... In Person The deadline is November 03, 2026 by 8:00 pm . Please visit your local board of elections' website for hours of operation.
mail_request.en_after: Requests to have a ballot mailed to you closed October 27, 2026. You can still request a print-at-home ballot through Friday, October 30, or request a ballot in person at your local board of elections until 8 p.m. on November 3. Check the board's hours before you go.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes para que te manden la boleta por correo cerraron el 27 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes pedir una boleta para imprimir en casa hasta el viernes 30 de octubre, o pedir una boleta en persona en la junta electoral de tu condado (local board of elections) hasta las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. Revisa el horario de la junta antes de ir.
mail_request.notes: Was missing the October 30 print-at-home option after October 27. Mail, drop box or fax requests must be received (not just mailed) by the same dates.

mail_return.en: By mail, it must be postmarked on or before Tuesday, November 3, and arrive by Friday, November 13. Putting it in a mailbox that day doesn't mean it gets that day's postmark. Drop box, polling place, early voting center or local board: by 8 p.m. on November 3. Printed your ballot at home? Use your own envelope and postage.
mail_return.es: Por correo, debe tener matasellos del martes 3 de noviembre o antes, y llegar a más tardar el viernes 13 de noviembre. Echarla al buzón ese día no significa que reciba el matasellos de ese día. En un buzón de entrega, un lugar de votación, un centro de votación anticipada o la junta electoral local: a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. ¿Imprimiste tu boleta en casa? Usa tu propio sobre y estampillas.
mail_return.quote: Your mail-in ballot must be mailed, dropped in a ballot drop box location (PDF) , or taken to a polling place, Early Voting Center or local board by 8:00 pm on Election Day . If you received your ballot by email, that email will contain a link to print and mail your ballot. You will need to provide your own envelope and postage to return the printed and marked ballot.
mail_return.notes: Receipt deadline: https://elections.maryland.gov/voting/canvassing.html (Oct 28) rejects a ballot 'postmarked after election day or received after the 2nd Friday after the election' (Nov 13). Postmark warning on the 2026 page: 'Putting your ballot in a mailbox on election day does not mean it is postmarked that day.'

early_hours.en: Every early voting center is open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. each day, including Saturday and Sunday.
early_hours.es: Todos los centros de votación anticipada abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m. todos los días, incluidos el sábado y el domingo.
early_hours.quote: If you prefer to vote in person, for the Gubernatorial General Election, early voting centers will be open from Thursday, October 22, 2026 through Thursday, October 29, 2026 from 7:00 am until 8:00 pm, including Saturday and Sunday.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended October 29. Vote at your assigned polling place on Election Day, 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el 29 de octubre. Vota en tu lugar de votación asignado el Día de las Elecciones, de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m.

cure.en: Forgot to sign the oath? Send a signed oath by 10 a.m. on Friday, November 13, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Olvidaste firmar el juramento? Envía el juramento firmado a más tardar a las 10 a. m. del viernes 13 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.en_after: The deadline to send a signed oath was 10 a.m. on Friday, November 13, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para enviar el juramento firmado fue a las 10 a. m. del viernes 13 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: The deadline for a voter to provide a signed oath is 10 am on the 2nd Friday after election day.
cure.notes: Second Friday after Nov 3: Nov 6, then Nov 13.

in_person.en: During early voting, you can vote at any early voting center in the county where you live. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place.
in_person.es: Durante la votación anticipada puedes votar en cualquier centro de votación anticipada del condado donde vives. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde.
in_person.quote: You may vote early at any early voting center in your county of residence.
in_person.en_after: Early voting ended October 29. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place.
in_person.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el 29 de octubre. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en tu lugar de votación asignado.

locator_label.en: Polling Place Search (Maryland State Board of Elections)
locator_label.es: Polling Place Search (Junta Electoral del Estado de Maryland)

accepted.notes: Most voters show no ID; only some first-time voters are asked. The 'Bring one of these' list would mislead, so the list stays out. The existing FAQ answer covers it.

without.en: Most voters don't show ID. If you're a first-time voter who's asked and can't show it, you vote a provisional ballot. For it to count, get ID to your local board of elections before 10 a.m. on Wednesday, November 11.
without.es: La mayoría de los votantes no muestra identificación. Si votas por primera vez, te la piden y no puedes mostrarla, votas con una boleta provisional. Para que cuente, entrega tu identificación a la junta electoral de tu condado (local board of elections) antes de las 10 a. m. del miércoles 11 de noviembre.
without.quote: For your ballot to count, provide ID to your local board of elections before 10 am on the 2nd Wednesday after election day.
without.notes: Second Wednesday after Nov 3: Nov 4, then Nov 11.

who.en: Any registered voter in Maryland can vote by mail-in ballot. You don't need a reason.
who.es: Cualquier votante registrado en Maryland puede votar con boleta por correo (mail-in ballot). No necesitas dar una razón.
who.quote: Any registered voter may vote by mail-in ballot. You don't need a reason to vote by mail-in ballot.

witness.en: Sign the oath that comes with your ballot, not the ballot. Don't sign your name or make any other mark on the ballot itself.
witness.es: Firma el juramento que viene con tu boleta, no la boleta. No firmes ni hagas ninguna otra marca en la boleta.
witness.quote: Do not sign your name or make any other mark on your ballot.
witness.notes: Was 'don't sign or mark the ballot itself outside the ovals', which left out write-in spaces.

cure.en: Forgot to sign the oath on your mail ballot envelope? Your local board will contact you by email, mail or phone. Send back a signed oath by 10 a.m. on Friday, November 13.
cure.es: ¿Olvidaste firmar el juramento en el sobre de tu boleta por correo? Tu junta electoral local te contactará por correo electrónico, correo o teléfono. Envía el juramento firmado a más tardar a las 10 a. m. del viernes 13 de noviembre.
cure.quote: The deadline for a voter to provide a signed oath is 10 am on the 2nd Friday after election day.
cure.notes: Second Friday after Nov 3: Nov 6, then Nov 13.
cure.en_after: The deadline to send a signed oath was 10 a.m. on Friday, November 13, 2026.
cure.es_after: La fecha límite para enviar el juramento firmado fue a las 10 a. m. del viernes 13 de noviembre de 2026.

dropbox.en: Drop boxes are open until 8 p.m. on Election Day. The locations come with your ballot. You can also hand it in at a polling place, an early voting center or your local board by 8 p.m.
dropbox.es: Los buzones de entrega están abiertos hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. Las ubicaciones vienen con tu boleta. También puedes entregarla en un lugar de votación, un centro de votación anticipada o la junta electoral de tu condado a más tardar a las 8 p. m.
dropbox.quote: Use a ballot dropbox, your ballot must be in a ballot dropbox by 8pm on Election Day. The ballot dropbox locations are included when we send you your ballot

gear.en: Wear your campaign shirt, button or sticker if you like, and leave right after you vote. Campaigning, like handing out fliers or holding signs, has to stay behind a line about 100 feet from the entrance (25 to 100 feet in Montgomery County).
gear.es: Puedes llevar tu camiseta, botón o sticker de campaña, y salir en cuanto votes. Hacer campaña, como repartir volantes o sostener letreros, tiene que quedarse detrás de una línea a unos 100 pies de la entrada (de 25 a 100 pies en el condado de Montgomery).
gear.quote: It is not electioneering if a voter wears campaign buttons, t-shirts, or stickers when voting. After voting, however, the voter must immediately leave the early voting center or election day voting center.

phone.en: Inside a polling place or early voting center, you can use your phone only to translate, show proof of where you live or ID, look up election information, or take a photo of your own marked ballot before you cast it, for personal use. Take your sticker selfie outside.
phone.es: Dentro de un lugar de votación o un centro de votación anticipada, solo puedes usar tu celular para traducir, mostrar tu comprobante de domicilio o tu identificación, revisar información electoral o tomarle una foto a tu propia boleta marcada antes de depositarla, para uso personal. Tómate la selfie con tu sticker afuera.
phone.quote: You cannot use your cell phone, pager, camera, and computer equipment in an early voting center or at a polling place except to use as a translation device, provide proof of residency or ID, review election information, and to record a digital image of your marked ballot prior to casting for personal use.

line.en: If you get to your polling place by closing time, stay. You can still vote.
line.es: Si llegas a tu lugar de votación antes de la hora de cierre, quédate. Todavía puedes votar.
line.quote: (b) A voter who has appeared at a polling place by the closing hour to cast a ballot shall be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: The State Board of Elections has I voted sticker designs you can download, including two that say it in English and Spanish. One puts an oriole, a crab, a racehorse and a black-eyed Susan on the state flag. Another shows the Bay Bridge with a heron underneath.
tradition.es: La Junta Electoral del Estado tiene diseños de stickers de "I voted" que puedes descargar, incluidos dos que lo dicen en inglés y en español. Uno pone una oropéndola (oriole), un cangrejo, un caballo de carreras y una flor black-eyed Susan sobre la bandera del estado. Otro muestra el puente de la bahía (Bay Bridge) con una garza abajo.
tradition.quote: Click to download the I VOTED sticker you like!

provisional.en: You vote a provisional ballot if your name isn't on the list, you moved without updating your address, or you need to prove where you live or show ID. It counts if you're registered and eligible and meet any extra steps. Check it on Voter Look-up 10 days after the election.
provisional.es: Votas con una boleta provisional si tu nombre no aparece en la lista, te mudaste sin actualizar tu dirección, o necesitas comprobar dónde vives o mostrar una identificación. Cuenta si estás registrado, puedes votar y cumples cualquier paso adicional. Revísala en Voter Look-up 10 días después de la elección.
provisional.quote: Your ballot will be counted if you are a registered voter, were eligible to vote by provisional ballot, and met any other applicable requirements (see above).

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone who gets to their polling place by closing time gets to vote.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que llegue a su lugar de votación antes de la hora de cierre puede votar.
line.quote: (b) A voter who has appeared at a polling place by the closing hour to cast a ballot shall be allowed to vote.

track.en: Use the Voter Look-up to see whether your local board got your request and where your mail-in ballot stands.
track.es: Usa Voter Look-up para ver si la junta electoral de tu condado recibió tu solicitud y en qué estado va tu boleta por correo.
track.quote: Visit the voter look-up website to verify if your local board of elections received your request for a ballot and the status of your mail-in ballot.

late_mail.en: Not if it's postmarked by Tuesday, November 3, and arrives by Friday, November 13. But a ballot dropped in a mailbox on Election Day may not get that day's postmark. To be safe, take it to a ballot drop box, your local board of elections, or a polling place by 8 p.m. on November 3.
late_mail.es: No, si tiene matasellos del martes 3 de noviembre o antes y llega a más tardar el viernes 13 de noviembre. Pero una boleta que echas al buzón el Día de las Elecciones quizás no reciba el matasellos de ese día. Para no correr riesgos, llévala a un buzón de entrega de boletas, a la junta electoral local (local board of elections) o a un lugar de votación a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre.
late_mail.quote: Your mail-in ballot must be mailed, dropped in a ballot drop box location (PDF) , or taken to a polling place, Early Voting Center or local board by 8:00 pm on Election Day . ... Your ballot must be postmarked on or before each election day to be counted. Putting your ballot in a mailbox on election day does not mean it is postmarked that day.
late_mail.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Nov 13 receipt: elections.maryland.gov/voting/canvassing.html (Oct 28) and the 2026 calendar. Ballot envelope: 'Drop off your ballot at any voting location in the county.' (Outgoing_Envelope-EN.pdf, Perplexity lead, not read). A 2014 page that bars polling-place return is superseded by the 2026 page.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on elections.maryland.gov (curl worked). Early voting dates in states.js (Oct. 22 to 29, 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.) match elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/index.html: 'early voting centers will be open from Thursday, October 22, 2026 through Thursday, October 29, 2026 from 7:00 am until 8:00 pm, including Saturday and Sunday.' The 2026 page says 'Mail-in ballots must be postmarked or placed in a designated ballot drop box by 8:00 pm on November 03, 2026'; the mail-in FAQ says only 'postmarked on or before election day'; no receipt deadline for postmarked ballots was found, so none is stated. The ID list for first-time voters (current photo ID, or a utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or government document dated within 3 months) is on election_day_questions.html; left out of id.accepted because most voters need no ID. Not found: mail-in cure process, witness rule (the page mentions only a signed oath), in-line-at-closing rule. The sticker designs are named from the download links' alt text on the 2026 page, not from a news release; no designer or contest is named there.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: (a) On an election day, a polling place shall be open from 7 a.m. until 8 p.m.
